title: MyWebsite
description: This website itself is a cool project, isn't it?
fullDescription:
The Philosophy: Brutalist Minimalism & Visual Silence
In a digital landscape filled with saturated colors and over-engineered interactions, this portfolio was built as an exercise in restraint. The design system follows a strict Black & White palette, where every pixel is intentional. Color is treated as a premium resource, only appearing when the user actively engages with a project or photograph. The use of bracketed UI elements and monospaced typography pays homage to terminal aesthetics while maintaining a premium, high-fashion editorial feel.

The Architecture: Dynamic, Server-First, and Scalable
The technical foundation is built on Next.js 16 and the App Router, prioritizing Server Components to ensure lightning-fast load times despite the use of high-resolution video backgrounds. Instead of a traditional database, the entire site is powered by a Git-based headless CMS (Decap CMS). Every project, photograph, and journal entry is stored as flat JSON files within the repository. This architecture ensures the site is 100% data-driven and manageable via a local admin interface, while remaining exceptionally cost-effective and portable.

The Experience: Cinematic Motion & Grain
To avoid the static nature of traditional portfolios, I implemented a custom background system that loops grainy, B&W visual fragments. A cinematic "dip-to-black" transition logic was built into the video engine to pre-emptively fade the background 0.8s before a video ends, ensuring a seamless loop. Combined with a global CSS grain overlay and scroll-triggered grayscale-to-color transitions, the site feels "grounded" and alive—reflecting the physical textures of film and analog noise.
